title: Source-selection bias can under-represent minority or local viewpoints
evidence: Linked limitations: Source-selection and credibility-rubric bias.
mitigation: Add multi-source retrieval diversification and periodic expert review of credibility rubric.

title: Overconfident outputs may mislead users in high-stakes domains
mitigation: Calibrate confidence and display uncertainty reasons with explicit human-review triggers.

title: Residual model error can amplify misinformation if used as sole authority
evidence: Observed error rate=0.286 in evaluation split.
mitigation: Position system as triage aid, not final truth authority; require human-in-loop for critical claims.

title: Debate mode may alter verdicts without guaranteed net safety improvement
evidence: Linked limitations: Debate arbitration can introduce regressions.
mitigation: Enable debate only when baseline uncertainty exceeds policy threshold.

title: Users may misunderstand confidence and think verdicts are definitive
evidence: Current UX exposes confidence numbers but users may interpret them as certainty.
mitigation: Add concise disclaimers and confidence interpretation bands in UI.
